suggested_ig_names.ig_devout: Cults of Ursun, Dazh and Tor

baseline.source: canon: WH: The Old World (2023+) Kislev background (Boyars under the Tzar/Tzarina); TW:WH3 Kislev; inferred for mundane law groups
baseline.why: Kislev is a boyar-ruled steppe monarchy with a gunpowder-capable but agrarian, cult-heavy society: peasant levies, hereditary boyar administration, land tax, guilds in its cities

ungol_tribe.source: canon: WFB Kislev / Ungol horse-nomads (Ungols are nomadic steppe riders bound by clan)
ungol_tribe.why: Nomadic clans keep no schools, bureaucracy or standing host beyond the clan warband, so they take the tribal package at tier 7 (no technology)

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB Kislev (Erengrad is the realm's trade port at the mouth of the Lynsk)
ruling_igs.why: Merchants share power with the boyars in the port city.

expected_government_type.why: Follows from the tag's laws at grand_principality tier.

laws.lawgroup_distribution_of_power.source: canon: WH: The Old World (2023+) Kislev background (ruled by the Tzarina from Kislev city)
laws.lawgroup_distribution_of_power.why: The Tzarina holds the Ice Court and the seat of the realm: autocracy for the capital oblast.

laws.lawgroup_army_model.source: canon: WFB Kislev (Tzar's Guard, Winged Lancers, Streltsi handgunners are standing troops)
laws.lawgroup_army_model.why: The Tzarina's own regiments are professional, unlike boyar levies elsewhere.

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB Kislev (Winged Lancers and Tzar's Guard beside the boyars)
ruling_igs.why: Court plus standing regiments rather than the cults.

expected_government_type.why: Follows from autocracy at grand_principality tier.

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB Kislev (Praag is the northern fortress-city facing Chaos)
ruling_igs.why: Garrison and boyars run a frontier city under permanent siege.

expected_government_type.why: Follows from the tag's laws at grand_principality tier.

tech_tier.why: A garrisoned Kislevite frontier keeps a standing host, one step above the nomad floor.
